units.source_text: 那天，病人的情况非常不好。

en.t: That day, the patient was in very poor condition.

units.source_text: 我起身去上厕所时，在走廊上碰见了哥哥。

en.t: When I got up to go to the toilet, I ran into my older brother in the corridor.

units.source_text: “上哪儿去？”

en.t: Where are you going?

units.source_text: 哥哥像个哨兵似的，喝住了我。

en.t: My older brother stopped me sharply, like a sentry.

units.source_text: 然后叮嘱我说：“今天的情况很不好，你可要尽量守在旁边啊。”

en.t: Then he warned me, saying, "Things are very bad today, so you should stay by his side as much as you can."

units.source_text: 我也是这样想的。

en.t: I thought so too.

units.source_text: 我又回到了病室，信仍然揣在怀里。

en.t: I returned to the sickroom, with the letter still tucked inside my clothes.

units.source_text: 父亲睁开眼睛问母亲，旁边的人都是谁。

en.t: Father opened his eyes and asked Mother who the people beside him were.

units.source_text: 母亲一一告诉给他，这个是谁，那个是谁，

en.t: Mother told him one by one who this person was and who that person was,

units.source_text: 每说一个人，父亲就点一点头。

en.t: and each time she named someone, Father gave a nod.

units.source_text: 若是没有点头，母亲就大声重复一遍这是某某先生，

en.t: If he did not nod, Mother would repeat loudly that this was such and such a gentleman,

units.source_text: 并叮问一遍：“听见了吗？”

en.t: and then ask insistently, "Did you hear me?"

units.source_text: “真是让你们受累了。”

en.t: I am truly sorry to have troubled you all.

units.source_text: 父亲说罢，又陷入了昏睡状态。

en.t: After Father said this, he sank back into a stupor.

units.source_text: 围在枕边的人都静静地观察着父亲的状况。

en.t: The people gathered around his pillow silently watched Father's condition.

units.source_text: 不一会儿，一个人起身到隔壁去了。

en.t: Before long, one person got up and went into the next room.

units.source_text: 随后又一个人出去了。

en.t: Then another person went out as well.

units.source_text: 之后，我也起身，回到了自己的房间。

en.t: After that, I too got up and returned to my own room.

units.source_text: 我是想看一直揣在怀里的信件才出来的。

en.t: I had come out because I wanted to read the letter I had been carrying inside my clothes.

units.source_text: 虽说在病人枕旁也可以看，

en.t: Although I could have read it at the patient's bedside,

units.source_text: 无奈这封信的分量太重，不可能在那里一口气看完，

en.t: the letter was too substantial, and it was impossible to read it through there in one sitting,

units.source_text: 所以我就趁着这个特殊时间来看信。

en.t: so I took advantage of this special moment to read it.

units.source_text: 我撕开很结实的包装纸，

en.t: I tore open the sturdy wrapping paper,

units.source_text: 拿出里面厚厚的一打字写得非常工整的稿纸。

en.t: and took out a thick sheaf of manuscript paper inside, filled with very neatly written characters.

units.source_text: 为便于封口，稿纸被叠成了四折。

en.t: To make it easier to seal, the manuscript paper had been folded into quarters.

units.source_text: 我把折出痕迹的洋纸反折了一下，展开弄平，好看信。

en.t: I folded the creased Western paper back the other way, spread it out, and smoothed it flat so I could read the letter.
